name: jewel_lace
description: fine copper lace on a blue-black ground, studded with lit jewels: the set's filigree a pale hair over engraved escape lines, small domed copper beads strung along its arms each with a white glint, and star points of light glittering where the lace is densest

reference.made_with: a flame fractal render (lace, lens petals and star flares), 2560x1600

reuses: gilded_orbs' ground: field de, inverted, through the map by rank (gamma 2.2 here): blue-black far from the set, the map's copper top beside it
gilded_orbs' engraving: a period sheet on field smooth (four fine lines a band), screened, and field tia multiplied in
glow_filaments' falloff glows on de: a dim haze 0.02 frame widths wide and a pale hair along the set
gilded_orbs' jewel on one bubble disc's bounded pullbacks (no spacing, escaped, largest 0.035): a flat fill, a domed light, a dark rim and a white glint
gilded_orbs' sparkle lattice (bubble discs at spacing 1, largest 0.025), masked to the set: a warm halo and a white core per point
the tone pass, at the reference's median and p10
notes: Discarded (item 046): Matt's verdict on round one, "nothing in here looks aesthetically interesting enough to add", kept nothing in the stack, so its maps (jewel_lace, jewel_lace_eternity) left the library (only picked palettes are saved); it suggests Claret Ember, the library map nearest jewel_lace by M1 when it was admitted. The one tile kept, jewel_lace_amber on soft_veils, became soft_veils' soft_veils_amber entry. No round two.

The look, refined from the three references: fractal_patterns_abstract_dark is fine cream-and-copper lace on a blue-black void, glittering with four-pointed star flares, its copper lens petals each lit from a bright centre; eternity-in-a-moment (exoteric.roach.org) is gold and ice-blue gear-lace round glossy blue orbs on deep blue; fractal-abstract-abstraction-art-artwork-wallpaper-17 is an amber flame flower whose only jewels are small gold droplets on hair stems. What the three share is the headline: fine structure studded with small lit points, never large ones.

Added: nothing new to the engine. The stack is gilded_orbs' ground and engraving without its period-1 ribbon light (the `ribbons` formulation puts it back, masked to the set), its orbs held to beads (largest 0.035, not 0.15) and its sparkle lattice grown from a pin-prick (largest 0.004) to a visible star point (largest 0.025, a halo under the core). Palette entries, one per reference: jewel_lace the default (patterns_abstract_dark); jewel_lace_eternity (blue beads, tone 0.335/0.119); jewel_lace_amber (gold beads, tone 0.332/0.188).

Lessons (round one, item 044): **a strip lattice is not a star flare**: hair strips at spacing 1 pull back as long frame-crossing hairs whatever `largest` says, since `largest` bounds a strip's width and not its length, so they fail the fractal-feel rule; round disc points with a halo stand in for the flares. **An angle sheet on a single disc's pullbacks reads as torn shards**, not rays, at seats where the discs pull back near a critical point (the `rays` formulation). The period-1 ribbon light paints the far field in broad satin tubes even masked by the inverted de; without it the void stays dark, as the reference's. eternity-in-a-moment is gilded_orbs' own artist and look; round one offers it both as a jewel_lace entry and on gilded_orbs.
